channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: ইসলামে বন্ধুত্বের গুরুত্ব ও পরকালের ছায়া
item.description: পরকালে আল্লাহর সন্তুষ্টির উদ্দেশ্যে গড়ে ওঠা বন্ধুত্ব বিশেষ মর্যাদা লাভ করবে। ইসলামে এই ধরনের সুসম্পর্ক ও তা বজায় রাখার ওপর বিশেষ গুরুত্ব দেওয়া হয়েছে।

item.title: Ipswich Earns 1-1 Draw Against Nottingham Forest
item.description: Ipswich manager Gary O'Neil lauded his squad's determination after they overcame a deficit to secure a 1-1 tie versus Nottingham Forest at Portman Road. The Premier League fixture showcased the team's resilience under pressure.

item.title: Trump Hints at Potential Action Concerning Cuba
item.description: Donald Trump and Marco Rubio have maintained a strict stance against Cuba's government. This follows earlier threats of possible United States military intervention involving the region.

item.title: Los Angeles Duo Launches Farm and Cider Enterprise
item.description: David Bailey and Dana Tiel abandoned their advertising jobs to acquire a 16-acre California property for $925,000. Following total investments reaching $1 million, they transformed a barn into a residence and established Sierra Cider.

item.title: Christian Wade Matches Premiership Try Record
item.description: Newcastle winger Christian Wade tied the Premiership Rugby try-scoring record with 101 tries, sharing the milestone with Chris Ashton. The achievement highlights the player's ongoing scoring consistency in the league.

item.title: US Administration Relaxes Specific Canadian Tariffs
item.description: The White House decided to reduce duties on select Canadian imports, including particular machinery, starting October 30. Simultaneously, new tariffs will apply to other merchandise like carpets ahead of midterm elections.

item.title: Actor Chloë Grace Moretz Sells Los Angeles Property
item.description: Chloë Grace Moretz parted with her Studio City residence for $5.65 million after acquiring the estate for $3.4 million in 2016 at age 19. The property includes various entertainment areas and was held for seven years.

item.title: Manager Glasner Questions Refereeing Decision at Ipswich
item.description: Nottingham Forest boss Oliver Glasner expressed bewilderment over a VAR ruling that spared Issa Diop a red card during a 1-1 stalemate with Ipswich Town. Despite the decision extending his team's winless run, Glasner commended their overall display.

item.title: OpenAI restricts internet access for advanced model training
item.description: Following recent incidents, OpenAI announced it will block internet access for its advanced models while they undergo training to implement enhanced safety protocols.

item.title: Balkan leaders expand security and political ties with Israel
item.description: Political figures across the Balkans are strengthening relations with Israel through increased cooperation in defense, surveillance, and political support.

item.title: Leclerc sets Austin practice pace from Verstappen
item.description: As reported by BBC Sport, Ferrari's Charles Leclerc is fastest from Red Bull's Max Verstappen in first practice at the United States Grand Prix. Key points: Leclerc, Austin, Verstappen Ferrari, Charles Leclerc.

item.title: Nvidia CEO demonstrates Microduck robots as initial stock sells out
item.description: Nvidia's chief executive showcased voice-activated Microduck robots that perform tricks, walk, and make robotic sounds as an initial batch of 20,000 units sold out.

item.title: Gloucester secures first home victory over Bath since 2022
item.description: Gloucester defeated rival Bath 23-5 at Kingsholm, achieving their first home win against them in the Premiership since April 2022 through strong defensive play.

item.title: Ukrainian soldier amputates own foot and survives months stranded
item.description: Trapped in a boiler room following a Russian drone strike, 49-year-old soldier Kostiantyn Vlasenko amputated his own foot to survive before drone rescue on October 4.

item.title: Wade ties Premiership try record as Newcastle defeats Sale
item.description: Christian Wade scored his 101st try, tying Chris Ashton's Premiership record, while Newcastle secured their first league victory of the season against Sale.

item.title: Nottingham Forest draws with Ipswich to escape relegation zone
item.description: Nottingham Forest stopped a three-game losing streak with a 1-1 draw against Ipswich Town, moving out of the relegation zone despite missing several scoring chances.

item.title: Littler advances while Van Gerwen exits European Championship
item.description: World champion Luke Littler advanced to the second round of the European Championship after defeating William O'Connor, while Michael van Gerwen was eliminated.

item.title: Xbox COO Helen Chiang Departs Microsoft After Two Decades
item.description: Helen Chiang is stepping down from her role as the inaugural chief operating officer of Xbox. Her departure from Microsoft concludes a 21-year tenure with the company, as detailed in an internal memo.

item.title: Jordanian Church Funeral Attacked by Gunmen, Seven Dead
item.description: Two masked assailants shot and killed seven individuals during a funeral service at a church in Karak, Jordan. The violent incident also left 34 other people injured.

item.title: Borussia Monchengladbach Secures First Victory of the Season
item.description: Borussia Monchengladbach overcame a deficit to defeat Stuttgart 3-2 in a five-goal match. This result marks the German club's initial league win after seven attempts this season.

item.title: French President Denounces Racism Following Paris-Area Attack
item.description: Emmanuel Macron condemned societal racism after a motorist shot and killed one person while wounding five others, including a child, near Paris. The ongoing investigation treats the shooting as a terrorist act.

item.title: ফ্রান্সে বাংলাদেশি ব্যবসায়ীদের প্রতিষ্ঠানে হামলা ও লুটপাট
item.description: ফ্রান্সে প্রবাসী বাংলাদেশিদের কয়েকটি দোকানে ভাঙচুর ও লুটপাটের ঘটনা ঘটেছে। এক ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত ব্যবসায়ী জানিয়েছেন, তাঁর দোকান থেকে প্রায় ৯০ হাজার ইউরো মূল্যের পণ্য লুট করা হয়েছে।

item.title: Runner Shares How Fitness Obsession Caused Anxiety
item.description: Wayne Davies developed a fitness addiction that caused persistent anxiety and sleep deprivation. He suffered from constant stress regarding race times and social media comparisons with other athletes.

item.title: Transfer Rumors: Aston Villa Doubts Garnacho Permanent Move
item.description: Aston Villa is reportedly reconsidering a permanent transfer agreement for Alejandro Garnacho. Meanwhile, Brighton plans to retain Diego Gomez amid external interest, and Manchester United managerial candidates have expressed player concerns.

item.title: France Deploys 70,000 Officers Ahead of Weekend Demonstrations
item.description: French authorities are mobilizing 70,000 police officers for upcoming weekend protests. Officials aim to curb potential vandalism, looting, and public violence during the demonstrations.

item.title: Argentina halts cryptocurrency fraud inquiry concerning President Milei
item.description: Authorities in Argentina closed an investigation involving Javier Milei. The leader had previously rejected allegations of deception linked to the collapse of a digital currency following the removal of his promotional online post.

item.title: ইউক্রেনীয় সেনার অঙ্গচ্ছেদ ও ড্রোনে পলায়ন
item.description: আট মাস বয়লারে লুকিয়ে থাকার পর নিজের পা কেটে ১৫ কিলোমিটার দূরে নিরাপদ স্থানে ড্রোন চড়ে ফিরে আসেন এক ইউক্রেনীয় সেনা। যুদ্ধক্ষেত্র থেকে জীবিত ফিরতে তিনি এই চরম পদক্ষেপ নেন।

item.title: RBI Governor confirms mandatory listing rules for upper-tier NBFCs
item.description: Reserve Bank chief Sanjay Malhotra reiterated that prominent shadow banks must go public. The remarks highlight compliance challenges for Tata Sons, though official penalties for failing to meet the mandate remain unspecified.

item.title: OpenAI shifts to offline environments for advanced artificial intelligence training
item.description: Following security breaches, OpenAI now trains its highest-level AI systems entirely offline. The organization established a localized testing framework utilizing cached and indexed internet materials.

item.title: Critical PHP software vulnerabilities prompt worldwide cybersecurity warning
item.description: Global digital infrastructure faces threats due to newly discovered PHP software bugs. Developers were urged to deactivate session upload features temporarily while awaiting official patches from maintainers.

item.title: Venture capitalists and Superhuman founder discuss product-market fit warning signs
item.description: Industry leaders from Iconiq, Sapphire Ventures, and Superhuman Mail outlined key indicators for evaluating market viability. They discussed best practices for avoiding common pitfalls during the development of successful commercial software.

item.title: Israeli youth demonstrate overwhelming political alignment with right-wing parties
item.description: Roughly three-quarters of young Jewish citizens voting for the first time lean toward conservative or center-right politics. This demographic support level surpasses the trends observed across the broader Israeli population.

item.title: Democratic FCC commissioner urges media outlets to counter political pressure
item.description: Regulator Anna Gomez cautioned television and radio networks against complying with political demands. She advised broadcasters to withstand pressure regarding allegations of biased reporting and inaccurate polling.

item.title: UN Warns Time Is Fading to Reach Taiz Amid Severe Crisis
item.description: United Nations officials report that time is running out to deliver assistance to Taiz. Over 800,000 residents have been isolated from relief supplies since Houthi forces surrounded the city in October.

item.title: United Kingdom Leads in Artificial Intelligence Layoffs
item.description: Job reductions linked to artificial intelligence are occurring in the United Kingdom at twice the frequency observed in the United States and Germany.

item.title: Iran Prepares Strategies to Target Regional Subsea Cables
item.description: Authorities state that Tehran possesses specific strategies to strike Gulf underwater cables if conflict restarts. This follows threats that regional marine cables might face attacks if talks with Washington fail.

item.title: Donald Trump Demands Resignation of Representative Ilhan Omar
item.description: Following a Department of Justice document referencing an alternate name, Donald Trump has demanded the resignation of Representative Ilhan Omar.

item.title: Examining Diagnostic Challenges of Multiple Sclerosis
item.description: Activist Christina Applegate recently stated that updated evaluations showed her multiple sclerosis diagnosis was mistaken. Medical experts examine why identifying this specific condition presents ongoing challenges.

item.title: Released American Citizen Faced Torture in Russian Detention
item.description: Former Ukrainian inmates who were imprisoned alongside a recently freed American citizen report observing guards subject him to physical assaults and sexual abuse while in Russian custody.

item.title: Kenya Confirms Second Fatality Due to Ebola
item.description: Medical authorities in Kenya reported that a 65-year-old female relative of a previous Ebola victim died from the virus. The patient fell ill while isolated in Nairobi.

item.title: Department of Energy Classifies Helium as Critical Material
item.description: The United States Department of Energy has classified helium as a critical material. This action supports efforts to decrease foreign mineral dependence and strengthen domestic production.

item.title: Igor Thiago reaches Brazil squad after humble beginnings
item.description: Brazilian forward Igor Thiago advanced from working as a bricklayer and garbage collector to earning a spot on Brazil's 2026 World Cup roster following a standout campaign with Brentford.

item.title: Alice Kinsella performs strong floor routine at World Championships
item.description: Gymnast Alice Kinsella successfully finished her comeback following a year-long break for childbirth by executing a strong floor routine during the women's all-around final in Rotterdam.

item.title: Former Slack CEO sells Aspen property for $30 million
item.description: Stewart Butterfield and Jen Rubio sold their Aspen residence for $30 million following their split. The pair initially purchased the home for $25 million in early 2021.

item.title: Trump scales back tariffs on Canada ahead of US midterms
item.description: Donald Trump reduced tariffs on Canadian goods as Republicans work to retain control of Congress. A key Senate candidate stated she pushed for the removal of these import duties.

item.title: Ukraine announces temporary ceasefire in Oleshky
item.description: The Ukrainian military command declared a localized ceasefire in the Russian-held town of Oleshky within the Kherson region to facilitate humanitarian work, starting October 27 at 3:00 am Kyiv time.

item.title: Pentagon memo cautions against prediction markets
item.description: Pete Hegseth issued a memo warning that prediction market wagering can distort military decisions and put service members at risk by revealing sensitive operational details to adversaries.

item.title: Russia and Ukraine accept ceasefire arranged by Melania Trump
item.description: President Trump stated that a localized ceasefire in Oleshky was established following a diplomatic effort initiated by First Lady Melania Trump.

item.title: Mehdi Hasan and Steve Cortes debate Trump policies
item.description: Mehdi Hasan and former Trump adviser Steve Cortes discussed economic conditions, immigration enforcement measures under ICE, and related issues during a policy debate.

item.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 Scheduled for Boston in November
item.description: The SoWa Power Station in Boston will host the TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 on November 4. The event gathers investors, operators, and entrepreneurs for discussions, networking, and workshops.

item.title: Fatal shooting at Jordanian funeral leaves six dead
item.description: Gunmen opened fire during a church funeral service in the Karak governorate of southern Jordan. Authorities report 28 injuries and have initiated a search for the attackers.

item.title: Tigray Rebel Leader Vows Resistance Despite Disarmament Calls
item.description: A rebel commander has promised to persist in combat against government-aligned forces. These troops previously captured the capital of the Tigray region in Ethiopia.

item.title: Trump Mentions Potential New Military Strike Against Iran
item.description: On Friday, US President Donald Trump stated that the nation might conduct another operation named 'Epic Fury' against Iran. He was referencing the prior joint Israeli-American military campaign that initiated the conflict in late February.

item.title: Google Privacy Policy Revision Mentions Gmail Data for Ads
item.description: Enabling the Personal Intelligence feature grants the corporation access to additional user data. This information is utilized for targeted advertising purposes.

item.title: Paris Shooting Incident Treated as Terrorist Act
item.description: Authorities are probing a fatal shooting near Paris as terrorism after one person died and five others sustained injuries. The alleged shooter is currently in custody.

item.title: Pilibhit electoral roll flaws prompt legal steps against staff
item.description: The State Election Commission announced that active and former election personnel will face legal proceedings following discovered flaws in Pilibhit constituency 127's voter registry.

item.title: Chennai Corporation Enhances Readiness for Monsoon and El Niño
item.description: Local authorities in Chennai are increasing their preparations. The measures are being taken in response to upcoming monsoon conditions and El Niño worries.

item.title: Prominent Figures Invited to Anirudh and Kavya's Chennai Reception
item.description: Music director Anirudh Ravichander and cricket franchise co-owner Kavya Maran are preparing for their wedding. Their families have extended reception invitations in Chennai to political figures for November 21.

item.title: India and Azerbaijan Repair Relations During Jaishankar's Visit
item.description: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar's trip to Baku marks a diplomatic reset between New Delhi and Azerbaijan. Bilateral ties had previously faced friction due to regional alliances involving Pakistan and Armenia.

item.title: CMDA Initiates ₹8.34-Crore Infrastructure Upgrade at Koyambedu Market
item.description: The CMDA is launching road and drainage projects valued at ₹8.34 crore at the Koyambedu market. Officials noted that while main road flooding has decreased, blockages continue in specific zones and the flower market.
